description.value: Hei Hei Rice Roll is a Chinese fast-food counter specialising in cheung fun — steamed rice noodle rolls — a popular Cantonese street-food staple. The Chinese name 囍記腸粉 signals a traditional Hong Kong-style offering, making it a quick and filling stop for cyclists passing through Richmond's busy Westminster Highway corridor. It is situated inside a larger commercial building (unit 2430), likely a food court or plaza.
